description: Everything the main window is allowed to ask of the core. No plugins: file dialogs stay on the Rust side through rfd, which was already a dependency. B-48: the devtools toggle is deliberately NOT listed. It was inert in release (the feature is not compiled in), but a capability file is the wrong place to lean on that — nothing in the frontend ever called it, so the permission was pure surface. Debug builds still get devtools through Tauri's own debug behaviour.
